## Objectives
- Recognize the role of transport in global trade.  
- Understand Japan’s dependence on maritime transport.  
- Examine Japan’s port infrastructure and logistics hubs.  

## Key Concepts
- Maritime transport and global shipping networks.  
- Japan’s major container ports.  
- Logistics and supply chain hubs.  

## Readings (Suggested)
- Davies, P. (2009). Japanese Shipping and Shipbuilding in the Twentieth Century: The Writings of Peter N. Davies. BRILL.
- OECD. (2016). Peer review of the Japanese shipbuilding industry. OECD.
- Shinohara, M. (2010). Maritime cluster of Japan: Implications for the cluster formation policies. Maritime Policy & Management, 37(4), 377–399.

## Discussion Questions
1. Why is maritime transport uniquely important for Japan?  
2. How can Japan strengthen resilience in its maritime links?
